profile.headline: Software Developer | React/Angular/Vue/Next, Java/.NET, REST APIs | B.S. in Computer Systems Technology
profile.summary: Full-Stack Software Developer with 5+ years of experience delivering scalable, high-impact web applications across React, Angular, Java/Spring Boot, and .NET ecosystems. Proven track record of improving performance, reducing production issues, and accelerating delivery through clean architecture, automation, and strong cross-team collaboration. Experienced in both enterprise and fast-paced contract environments.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop responsive React-based user interfaces using reusable component patterns, improving usability and reducing UI-related defects across key product flows.
•	Design and implement secure, scalable backend services in .NET Core/.NET 8, supporting core business logic and API integrations.
•	Optimize SQL Server database schemas and queries to improve data reliability and application performance under production workloads.
•	Integrate and stabilize RESTful APIs across internal and external systems, strengthening error handling and system interoperability.
•	Diagnose and resolve complex full-stack issues spanning UI, backend services, and databases, reducing recurring production defects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Resolved 100+ high-priority React UI defects, reducing average resolution time by ~30% and improving end-user experience across production surfaces.
•	Automated recurring troubleshooting and diagnostic workflows, increasing operational efficiency by ~25%.
•	Investigated backend and UI service failures through log analysis and release validation, identifying root causes tied to service events and code rollouts.
•	Collaborated cross-functionally with engineers and product managers to triage issues, prioritize fixes, and stabilize application releases.
•	Authored and maintained technical documentation to accelerate onboarding and improve long-term knowledge sharing.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Built and maintained cross-browser Angular applications, improving front-end performance and responsiveness by ~15%.
•	Improved post-deployment reliability by ~20% through comprehensive UI unit testing using Karma and test-driven development practices.
•	Managed and optimized CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions, enabling consistent, automated deployments.
•	Collaborated with product managers and engineering teams to scope features, align on timelines, and deliver against release goals.

positions.description:
•	Developed and maintained Java-based backend services aligned with business and technical requirements in enterprise environments.
•	Resolved 50+ production issues via ServiceNow, improving system stability and reducing recurring user-reported defects.
•	Improved backend performance and test coverage using JUnit, Mockito, and TDD practices.
•	Built responsive UI components with Angular and Bootstrap, increasing cross-platform usability and engagement by ~25%.
